title: Will Trump say "Golden Dome" before Nov 1, 2026?
rules: If Golden Dome, or a plural or possessive form of Golden Dome, is stated by Donald Trump after October 1, 2026 at 10:00am ET and before Nov 1, 2026 at 12:00am ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Payout criteria
The word or phrase must be stated by President Donald Trump in public statements, direct quotes published by Source Agencies, or written public statements on his personal social media accounts (Twitter/Truth Social).
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
 Official acts like Executive Orders or bills signed do not count. 
 Grammatical/tense inflections.

blind.reasoning: Golden Dome is one of Trump's signature projects. He has repeatedly named it in speeches and on Truth Social, and it is in the news this month because of a funding fight. He is giving midterm rally speeches almost daily through October, so a direct quote between Oct 1 and Nov 1 is very likely. I couldn't confirm a specific October quote, so some risk remains that he sticks to domestic campaign themes.
blind.falsifier: A transcript review of Trump's October 1-31, 2026 rallies, interviews, and Truth Social posts finds no instance of him saying or writing 'Golden Dome'.

final.reasoning: The low price hints that traders may have checked and found no October mention so far, so I lowered my estimate. With frequent rallies and an active Golden Dome funding story, I still think a mention before Nov 1 is well above the ask.
